youtube_full.title: Honey Bunny Can't Sleep 🐰🌙 | Bedtime Story for Kids | Honey Bunny Kidz
youtube_full.text:
Honey Bunny can't fall asleep! 🐰 So she and Mama Bunny peek outside to ask her friends for their sleepy secrets. Count the stars with Dotty the Duckling ⭐, breathe slowly with Ollie the Owl 🦉, and say goodnight to Mister Moon 🌙.

A calm, gentle bedtime story for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 2–6), with counting and a simple breathing exercise to help little ones relax before sleep.

💤 Sweet dreams from Honey Bunny Kidz!
